__comment: AWS IoT Fleet Provisioning template (Slice 6 deliverable). Register as e.g. 'bt-panel-provisioning' with a pre-provisioning Lambda hook if allow-listing serials. tools/provision-panel.js sends parameters CustomerId/SiteId/PanelId/SerialNumber; the thing name and topic namespace derive from them. Attach the per-device policy (iot-policy-panel.template.json, registered as 'bt-panel-policy'). REQUIRES the thing type 'bt-panel' to exist first (aws iot create-thing-type --thing-type-name bt-panel) - AWS allows at most 3 attributes on an untyped thing, and this template sets 4.
